The company shows solid operating profitability (EBIT/Revenue ~18%) and reasonable balance-sheet leverage, with shareholders’ equity (64,923M) comparable to total liabilities (57,549M). Liquidity is adequate but not strong (current ratio 1.32), suggesting some constraint in near-term coverage versus higher-rated issuers. Overall, this profile supports an investment-grade rating at the lower end of the top tier.

DECISION: A-
